# Rebuilding the bundled Arabic phonemizer

Source snapshot: `oddadmix/nabra-tts` commit
`16b5281ce61993df3526740990cf845a3f3036f4`.

The original TypeScript G2P files, vocabulary, eSpeak wrapper and build script
are provided here. The compiled eSpeak module used in the published bundle was
supplied by that upstream snapshot. Its source is eSpeak NG 1.52.0 plus
`espeak/wrapper.c`; the complete eSpeak source archive is alongside this source
directory, one level above it.

To build the C/WASM module, extract the eSpeak archive into `espeak/src`, install
Emscripten, and follow `espeak/build.sh`. That upstream script obtains the
1.52.0 compiled language data from `espeakng_loader` (Python) and embeds Arabic
and English data. It records all compiler/linker flags. Upstream does not record
a specific Emscripten release, so a byte-for-byte rebuild of the original WASM
is not asserted. The corresponding dictionary and phoneme sources are included
in the eSpeak archive.

After the script creates `src/vendor/espeak-ng-ar.mjs`, bundle the public API
using esbuild version 0.25.12:

```sh
esbuild g2p-entry.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --minify \
  --define:process=undefined --external:node:module --outfile=../phonemizer.mjs
```

The browser build removes the Node-only loader branch. All eSpeak WASM and
language data are embedded; no model or dictionary is fetched by this module.
If the generated bytes change, update the pinned digest and byte size in the
application's download descriptor before distributing that changed bundle.
